# sleep

Pause the current DCode execution for seconds.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `function.sleep` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | DCode Functions |
| Family | Utility |
| Monaco kind | `function` |
| Format | `sleep(seconds)` |
| Valid contexts | `file`, `executable` |
| Autocomplete | `sleep(1.0)` |

## Example

```lua
sleep(1.0)
```
